notes.title: Time to move on!
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

We have to make an important announcement today, for everyone owning one or more of our games. 

It's been a long and exciting journey in this whole Steam family with plenty of experiences and exciting times. We are thankful that we could be part of all of this.

But everything ends eventually and so does our journey on Steam and as a company.

We will close our doors and wish you great fun with the remains that will stay here on Steam.

The game will be removed from the store but if you already own it, you will keep it in your library.

notes.title: F2P and matchmaking issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The transition to free-to-play is complete! 

However during that process the matchmaking permissions for steamworks got revoked resulting in temporary unavailable matchmaking. I myself can do nothing about it and have to wait for a valve employee to re-set them. 

I apologize for any inconveniences this creates. I will notify once the matchmaking is up again.

notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The DLC is finally finished and the patch just went live. Everyone who has bought or will buy the game untill it goes into F2P state will automatically get the DLC assigned to their account. 

The shift to F2P will be done as soon as possible!

DLC Content:

The DLC contains hats and skins for you character and let's you customize it to not look like everyone else.

notes.title: Loot'N Shoot is turning into a free-to-play game
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since the release of Loot'N Shoot I've been trying to address every issue players had as best as I could, however there was always one thing that couldn't really be fixed by a patch - the player base - which Loot'N Shoot is sadly lacking right now. So, after some weeks have passed we've finally made the decision to transit the game to free to play in an attempt to gain an active player base.

To compensate every player that has bought the game we will be granting them a paid DLC for free. I can not yet fully disclose what that said DLC will be besides being solely cosmetic.

We try to complete this transition untill december.

Meanwhile have a great time in game and life! :)

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 30 / 17
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today is patch-day!

It contains the new locomotion system that allows you to dash when double tapping sprint and a reduced base movement speed. This regains more control of the character and retains quick locomotion around the map once you've mastered the dashing.

It also contains a reworked jumping system that is more forgiving and will prevent falling from edges when pressing jump too late.

Have fun and good luck everyone!

notes.title: Current things being worked on
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The upcoming patch will contain a major rework of the movement system where the player speed is reduced to the previous values with the addition of forward dashing when double tapping the sprinting key. 

This allows us to regain more control of the character as well as quick and tactical locomotion around the map.

In addition to this we're working on completing the achievement system.

The patch will be deployed some time next week.

notes.title: Transition from Early Access to full release!
notes.content:
Today is a big day, the game finally left the early access stage. 

Everything that we wanted to test and introduce during early access have successfully been introduced over the last weeks. That's why we transitioned to full release today.

We of course will continue to work and improve the game. The next highest priority is finishing all achievements and balancing the items properly.

We're also preparing some halloween related stuff for next month!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30412463/eb40ef22ee3d0535dc1ab1d910afaddaccf74f48.png[/img]

Meanwhile enjoy the release! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 06 / 17
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Today's the day! New patch is here!

The new patch contains the following:

A practice mode available through the main menu where you can practice your shooting skills on floating dummies on a selected map (singleplayer)

A major rebalancing of weapons to lengthen the playtime of the match a bit and make them less risky and more fun in the sense that they have more ammunition, less damage and lesser risk of backfiring now.

The first two achievements made it in as well. They're really easy achievements to start of with, there will be more challenging ones in the future.

You're standing now closer to items/weapons in boxes when looting since the player can now walk through the boxes (projectiles and thrown items can't) This is to help any stucking looting issues that have been there before.

The weapons and boxes highlighting is now done in a per range basis which means if they're in reach of the player they will be highlighted regardless of looking at them, this is to gain some performance and prevent some hiccups we've experienced before.

The player names in the lobby are now longer and wont be cut too short.

Added the "Sprint" key to the control sheet on the main menu.

Fixed an issue with the signal torch not burning for the other players when picking it up yourself.

We hope this will bring quite the enjoyment! And happy looting and shooting!

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.content:
The upcoming patch will contain quite some stuff.

- Practice Mode (Singleplayer, as mentioned in the previous announcement)
- Item rebalancing (Less risky, less damage, more ammunition, prolonged battles)
- Achievements
- Edited post processing effects
- Adjusted box collision to enable quicker and more direct looting
- Reworked the highlighting system of items/weapons in an optimizing manner

There is no ETA yet but it wont take too long to finish it up (most likely by friday)



After that patch the main focus will be on:

- enabling endgame chat
- adding the ability to rematch in private/friends only lobbies
- option for visible name tags above players
- indicator for how many players are remaining
- adding a display for the achieved place after getting killed

notes.title: Practice Mode
notes.content:
We're currently working on a single player "Practice" mode where you can train your shooting skills on dummies.

This is also to ensure some gameplay even in times of few multiplayer games available.

Thanks to everyone who has joined our community so far!
